title: Windows Update
summary: Update installs, failures and servicing problems.

events.title: An update was installed
events.meaning: Windows Update installed an update successfully. The message names the update.
events.next: Use it to see when the last update was installed.

events.title: An update failed to install
events.meaning: Windows Update could not install an update. The message holds the update name and an error code.
events.causes: Not enough disk space, a damaged update cache, or a conflict with other software.
events.next: Note the error code and search for it. Free disk space and try the update again.

events.title: Windows started installing an update
events.meaning: Windows Update began installing an update.
events.next: If no install success follows soon after, look for a failure event nearby.

events.title: A Windows component change finished
events.meaning: The servicing stack finished changing a package, which is how updates and features are installed.
events.next: No action needed unless it is followed by failure events.

events.title: Windows servicing reported a problem with a package
events.meaning: The servicing stack logged a warning while changing a package.
events.causes: A damaged component store, an interrupted update, or a conflict.
events.next: If updates fail, run the Windows repair tools such as DISM and SFC, and try again.
